findings.message: The Drizzle projection declares a column that no reviewed migration creates, so the migration alignment test fails.
evidence: command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run packages/web/src/server/database/migrations.test.ts

findings.message: Pending outbox events need a named dispatcher with retry, backoff, and visible failure before search or cache side effects depend on them.
The design assumes exactly one active publication job per scheduled article, as reader visibility and schedule cancellation already require.
Permanent deletion and the retention window for soft-deleted stories and their media need an explicit decision and owner.
